description: agentsmirror: block high-quota manifest pollers and unauthorized backend sync proxies at Edge WAF
expression: (http.host in {"codexapp.agentsmirror.com" "codexapp-r2.agentsmirror.com" "claudeapp.agentsmirror.com" "claudeapp-r2.agentsmirror.com"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/terms") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/stats/") and (lower(http.user_agent) contains "kakou/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "auto-gateway-codex" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "codexdownloadproxy" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "hermes-cron" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "yumebox" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "awariobot" or ip.src in {43.153.215.201 152.53.160.132 15.235.198.243 2402:1f00:8000:800::2245})
